chunks.content: The PostgreSQL container enables the uuid-ossp and vector extensions via CREATE EXTENSION statements during initialisation. The pgvector extension is required for the chunk_embeddings table.
The default vector dimension configured for the chunk_embeddings column is 1536, matching the OpenAI text-embedding-3-small output.
The project pins Python 3.12 in pyproject.toml and CI installs the version using pyenv or the official python-version action.
uv is the chosen package manager. CI uses `uv sync --locked --all-extras` and `make check` for the deterministic gate.
The outbox table stores pending, claimed, completed, or dead-letter events with idempotency keys, claim tokens, lease expiry, and bounded retry attempts.
The HTTP API uses FastAPI with the official OpenAPI docs and health check endpoint. Pydantic v2 is used for request/response validation.
Neo4j is reached through the official neo4j-driver package. All queries are parameterised Cypher to keep the surface area small and safe.
Phoenix is the local OpenTelemetry trace UI. The Collector receives OTLP/HTTP traces and forwards them to Phoenix over the same protocol.
Prometheus scrapes the application /metrics endpoint and Grafana visualises the time series. The local Prometheus and Grafana services are part of docker-compose.
Object storage uses MinIO locally and the AWS S3 SDK as the client. Documents are stored under a per-tenant prefix.
Runtime validation is enforced at every external boundary using Pydantic v2 models. The domain layer exposes Pydantic-inferred types but does not import Pydantic as a runtime value at any other site.
Documents are versioned through immutable document_versions rows. Each version has a UUID identifier, a content hash, and a checksum; the row itself is never updated.
Knowledge facts store validFrom, validTo, observedAt, and supersededBy fields so the system preserves historical truth.
Access control filtering is applied inside the repository layer (SQL or Cypher) before any result leaves the data store.
Execution steps transition pending -> running -> succeeded | failed | skipped | cancelled. Terminal states cannot transition again.
Execution runs transition pending -> running -> succeeded | partially_succeeded | failed | cancelled.
Telemetry attributes must not include raw document content, prompts, responses, embeddings, secrets, or principal lists.
OpenTelemetry traces are exported over OTLP/HTTP to the local Collector, which forwards them to Phoenix.
Default fusion combines vector search and full-text search via reciprocal rank fusion with configurable weights and dedup by chunk id.
Knowledge facts use the status values candidate, verified, rejected, and superseded. The superseded status indicates a fact that has been replaced by a later verified fact.
Evaluation thresholds require citation coverage >= 95% and citation correctness >= 95% before a release can pass the gate.
Evaluation datasets are versioned JSONL files. The case id, dataset version, and answer run version are stored on every result.
Vector search uses an HNSW index over the embedding column with vector_cosine_ops to support nearest neighbour queries at low latency.
Full-text search uses a generated tsvector column with a GIN index and ts_rank_cd scoring. The chunk content is the only tokenised field.
The OpenTelemetry trace signal carries spans. The log signal carries structured events. The metric signal carries numeric measurements.
Branded Python types (TenantId, SourceId, DocumentId, ...) are declared as NewType or TypedDict variants so they cannot be assigned to a plain str by accident.
Each chunk row carries a stable id, a content hash, and a sequence number. The hash is used for change detection during ingestion.
Outbox workers claim events using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. The claim sets the lease token, worker id, and the next available time deterministically.
The OpenAI embedding adapter retries up to 3 times by default. Retries use exponential backoff and only fire for transient errors.
The evidence reranker scores each chunk against the query using a GPT-based 1-5 relevance scale, then sorts evidence descending by relevance score.
`make check` is the deterministic gate. It runs format:check, ruff, pyright, mypy, and unit tests in that order.
Access control is evaluated inside the repository query so no unfiltered data ever reaches the model. This is the pre-retrieval authorisation rule.
Every claim produced by the M4 vector pipeline must cite an immutable chunk via a deterministic citation id and an evidence id pointing at the same chunk.
Knowledge fact confidence is a finite number in the range [0, 1]. Out-of-range values are rejected by a database check constraint.
